guarantees.claim: On asynchronous reset (rst_ni low), baud_div_q is cleared to 0 and tick_baud_q is cleared to 0.

When tick_baud_x16 is high and not in reset, the 5-bit concatenation {tick_baud_q, baud_div_q} is updated to {1'b0, baud_div_q} + 5'h1, incrementing the 4-bit divisor and setting tick_baud_q to the carry when overflow occurs.
When tick_baud_x16 is low and not in reset, tick_baud_q is forced to 0; baud_div_q retains its previous value because it is not assigned in this branch.
